description:
`StartingWorkers.worker_paths_from_disk/1` (lib/bedrock/service/foreman/starting_workers.ex:22-27) globs EVERY entry under the foreman's path and treats each as a worker directory:

    def worker_paths_from_disk(path) do
      path |> Path.join("*") |> Path.wildcard()
    end

But the foreman's path is also the parent of two directories that are structurally guaranteed not to be workers:

- `object_storage/` - `cluster_supervisor.ex:241` derives `object_storage_root = Path.join(path, "object_storage")` from the very same `:path` config it hands the Foreman.
- `raft/` - `coordinator/server.ex:355` derives `working_directory = Path.join(base_path, "raft")`.

Both are enumerated, both fail manifest load with `:manifest_does_not_exist`, and both land in the worker map as `{:failed_to_start, _}`.

## Failure scenario

`Health.compute_health_from_worker_info/1` (foreman/health.ex:11-17) folds worker healths. The second `{:failed_to_start, _}` in the fold produces `{:failed_to_start, :at_least_one_failed_to_start}`. With `object_storage/` and `raft/` both present - which is every deployment using a shared working directory - there are always at least two such entries, so the foreman is PERMANENTLY unhealthy regardless of whether every real worker started fine. `Foreman.wait_for_healthy/2` never returns `:ok`.

Observed on a live 10-day cluster: /tmp/bedrock_00000 holds `object_storage/`, `raft/`, three live worker dirs, and three manifest-less orphans side by side.

## Secondary: no reclamation path

Directories that fail to load sit in the worker map as `:failed_to_start` forever. The only reclamation is `Foreman.remove_worker/3` -> `cleanup_worker_directory/2` -> `File.rm_rf`, which nothing calls for them. On the observed cluster that is 129 MB across `ta2y6ro4/` (an orphaned Shale log, untouched since Aug 20), `aflw25ra/`, and `d4if54s2/`.

## Fix

Identify worker directories by the presence of a readable manifest, not by 'is an entry under path'. A directory without a loadable manifest is not a worker and must not enter the worker map or the health fold.

Do NOT auto-delete manifest-less directories as part of this ticket - a log worker's WAL is real data and deleting it is destructive. Reclamation policy is a separate decision; note it and leave the directories in place.

## Test (write first, must fail)

Point a foreman at a tmp dir containing a valid worker directory plus `object_storage/` and `raft/`. Assert: (a) the worker map contains only the real worker, (b) foreman health is `:ok`, not `{:failed_to_start, _}`. Add a case for a manifest-less orphan dir - excluded from the map, left on disk.
title: [BUG] Foreman enumerates object_storage/ and raft/ as workers; health permanently degraded
